Summarise shots by zone (with shrinkage)

Source: R/shots.R
summarise_zones.Rd

Attempts, makes, FG%, points per shot and share of attempts per zone, plus the league average in the same zone and the player's FG% shrunk towards it (see shrink_rate()).

Usage

summarise_zones(
  shots,
  by = NULL,
  baseline = shots,
  detail = FALSE,
  prior_n = 30
)

Arguments

shots

Shot data (see Details in plot_shot_hex()).

by

Grouping columns (character), e.g. "player".

baseline

Shots used for the league reference; defaults to shots. Pass the whole league so a single player is compared with everyone.

detail

Use the 12 side-split zones.

prior_n

Strength of the pull towards the league zone average, in attempts: a zone with prior_n attempts is moved halfway.

Examples

zs <- summarise_zones(subset(shots_2024, player == "Stephen Curry"),
                      baseline = shots_2024, by = "player")
zs[, c("zone", "attempts", "fg", "fg_league", "fg_shrunk")]
#> # A tibble: 5 × 5
#>   zone            attempts    fg fg_league fg_shrunk
#>   <fct>              <int> <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1 Rim                  243 0.601     0.625     0.603
#> 2 Short mid-range      139 0.439     0.440     0.439
#> 3 Long mid-range        92 0.5       0.413     0.479
#> 4 Corner 3              85 0.482     0.388     0.458
#> 5 Above-break 3        699 0.386     0.351     0.385
